thread:
elena: Legal asked for a compact export of "who changed routing policies" (who, when, what, tenant). Need API + console plan.

mike: NDJSON preferred. Must include event_id, ts, tenant_id, actor_id, action, resource, compact_diff, request_id/trace_id, rollout_id.

raj: Worker should stream into chunks (e.g. 50MB) with manifest listing chunk keys + checksums + event_count. Include cursor+chunk_index for streaming replay.

jess: Quotas: per-org monthly export bytes + concurrent jobs (default 1). Console should show estimated bytes + quota impact before submit.

tariq: Telemetry fields: trace_id, route_eval_id, policy_version, cluster_id so console can link traces and policy diffs.

mike: Pseudonymize option: replace actor_id with stable per-job pseudo, include encrypted actor_map for org admins (KMS) if requested.

elena: UX: preview sample (default 5 rows), counts (events, unique actors), size estimate, redaction mode toggle (none|mask_pii|strip_sensitive). Warn if request exceeds tenant retention.

raj: include_actor_snapshot boolean for optional actor snapshots (actor_id -> display_name,email_hash,resolved_at) as separate NDJSON inside bundle.

mike: Tamper-evidence: sign manifest with ed25519 export key. Manifest contains job_id, root_hash_of_chunks, signer, signed_at, requested_by. Provide public key endpoint for verification.

jess: API sketch: POST /v1/audit/exports {tenant_ids, from, to, format:ndjson, pseudonymize, include_actor_snapshot, preview_sample_size, notify} -> 202 {job_id, estimated_size_bytes}. GET /v1/audit/exports/:id -> status + presigned_urls.

elena: Security: org-admin required, rate-limit by org, 2FA for big windows (>30d) or >X bytes. Log export_request metric.

audit-bot: job 5370012345-0 queued by elena (preview). ETA ~40s.

elena: Owners: mike API/signing, raj worker/chunking, jess quotas/console, tariq telemetry. I'll draft RFC and mockups. Closing thread.
